findings.evidence: A. The Service will at times place and/or store code or other types of information and/or devices (e.g., cookies) on your computer, mobile or other device (Local Device Storage). We may use Local Device Storage for any lawful business purpose, including without limitation to determine which of our messages have been opened by recipients so we can gauge the effectiveness of marketing campaigns, to control the display of ads, to track usage patterns, the movements of individual users, and your geographic location, to help diagnose problems with our servers, to gather broad demographic information, to analyze trends, to conduct research, to deliver editorial content, to record registration and personalization information, and to otherwise administer the Service.
findings.rationale: The policy mentions sharing of personal data for various purposes but does not specify sharing of location data with Google AdMob.
The policy does not specify a retention period for cookies and tracking elements used for advertising.
